import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Node {
        int age;
        List<Edge> adjusted;
        Edge back;

        public Node() {
            this.age = 0;
            this.adjusted = new ArrayList<>();
            this.back = null;
        }
    }

    static class Edge {
        Node from, to;
        int flow;
        Edge opposite;

        public Edge(Node from, Node to, int flow, Edge opposite) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.flow = flow;
            this.opposite = opposite;
        }
    }

    static class Queue<T> extends LinkedList<T> {
        public boolean offer(T t) {
            add(t);
            return true;
        }

        public T poll() {
            return remove(0);
        }

        public boolean isEmpty() {
            return size() == 0;
        }
    }

    public static int adjust(Edge e, int d) {
        if (e == null) return d;
        d = adjust(e.from.back, Math.min(d, e.flow));
        e.flow -= d;
        e.opposite.flow += d;
        return d;
    }

    public static void connect(Node a, Node b, int w) {
        Edge ea = new Edge(a, b, w, null);
        Edge eb = new Edge(b, a, 0, ea);
        ea.opposite = eb;
        eb.opposite = ea;
        a.adjusted.add(ea);
        b.adjusted.add(eb);
    }

    public static int maxFlow(List<Node> g, Node source, Node sink) {
        int result = 0;
        while (true) {
            for (Node u : g) {
                u.age = 0;
            }
            Queue<Node> q = new Queue<>();
            q.offer(source);
            source.age = 1;
            while (!q.isEmpty() && sink.age != 1) {
                Node u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : u.adjusted) {
                    Node v = e.to;
                    if (v.age != 0 || e.flow == 0) continue;
                    v.back = e;
                    v.age = u.age + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
            if (sink.age == 0) break;
            for (Edge e : sink.adjusted) {
                Edge o = e.opposite;
                if (o.from.age != sink.age - 1 || o.flow == 0) continue;
                result += adjust(o, o.flow);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        int T = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        while (T-- > 0) {
            StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            char[][] lab = new char[n][n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                lab[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
            }
            List<Node> g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < (m + 1) * n * n + 2; i++) {
                g.add(new Node());
            }
            Node source = g.get((m + 1) * n * n + 1);
            Node sink = g.get((m + 1) * n * n + 2);
            List<int[]> z = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    if (lab[r][c] == 'Y') continue;
                    if (lab[r][c] == 'Z') {
                        z.add(new int[]{r, c});
                        continue;
                    }
                    connect(source, g.get((m + 1) * r * n + c + 1), lab[r][c] - '0');
                    lab[r][c] = '0';
                }
            }
            for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                String row = br.readLine();
                for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                    if (row.charAt(c) == 'Y' || row.charAt(c) == 'Z') continue;
                    connect(g.get((m + 1) * r * n + c + 1), sink, row.charAt(c) - '0');
                }
            }
            int[] dr = {1, 0, -1, 0};
            int[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};
            for (int t = 0; t < m; t++) {
                // connect corridors
                for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                    for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                        connect(g.get((t + 1) * n * n + r * n + c), g.get(t * n * n + r * n + c), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                        if (lab[r][c] != '0') continue;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int r_ = r + dr[d];
                            int c_ = c + dc[d];
                            if (r_ < 0 || r_ >= n || c_ < 0 || c_ >= n || lab[r_][c_] != '0') continue;
                            connect(g.get((t + 1) * n * n + r * n + c), g.get(t * n * n + r_ * n + c_), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                }
                // spread
                List<int[]> z_ = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int[] e : z) {
                    int r = e[0];
                    int c = e[1];
                    for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                        int r_ = r + dr[d];
                        int c_ = c + dc[d];
                        if (r_ < 0 || r_ >= n || c_ < 0 || c_ >= n || lab[r_][c_] != '0') continue;
                        z_.add(new int[]{r_, c_});
                        lab[r_][c_] = 'Z';
                    }
                }
                Collections.swap(z_, z);
            }
            pw.println(maxFlow(g, source, sink));
        }
        pw.close();
    }
}
